cards.name: Theme
cards.description: The look of the top panel, this config menu, the fishing bar and many more parts of HeadsUp.

settings.name: Theme
settings.tip: The look of the top panel, its pop-outs, this config window, the fishing bar and many more parts of HeadsUp. Your own themes are listed under the built-in ones.

settings.name: Delete Custom Theme
settings.tip: Deletes this custom theme's file from the themes folder, and goes back to the built-in theme it was first copied from.

cards.name: Customize Appearance
cards.description: Every part of the theme in use. Changing one on a built-in theme makes a custom theme from it, named after it, and picks it. A custom theme saves each change as you make it, in config/headsup/themes.

settings.name: Theme Name
settings.tip: The custom theme's name, which is its file's name too. It changes once you click out of the box or close this window.

settings.name: Background Style
settings.tip: What the top panel's strip is drawn with.

options.name: Plain
options.tip: One color, with its opacity.

options.name: Gradient
options.tip: A top color running into a bottom color.

options.name: Vanilla Window
options.tip: The game's own window art, of the Window Type below.

settings.name: Background Color
settings.tip: The strip's one color, with its opacity: lower it to see the game through the strip.

settings.name: Top Color
settings.tip: The strip's color at its top, with its opacity.

settings.name: Middle Color
settings.tip: The panel's color just past halfway down its gradient.

settings.name: Bottom Color
settings.tip: The strip's color at its foot, with its opacity.

settings.name: Background Opacity
settings.tip: How much of the game shows through the top panel's strip. At 100% none of it does.

settings.name: Window Type
settings.tip: Which of the game's eight window frames the art is. Auto is the one picked in the game's Config, Windows, Shared, followed as you change it. Default: Auto.

settings.name: Separator Style
settings.tip: The shape of the top panel's separators, and what a dash (-) in a nameplate's design is drawn as.

options.name: Dash
options.tip: A plain dash: the top panel shows short lines, and a nameplate's dashes stay as they are.
Dot
Square
Diamond

settings.name: Border Thickness
settings.tip: How many pixels thick the border is: the line along the strip's foot, or with Vanilla Window the frame around the top panel, the help bar, the pop-outs, the fishing bar and this window. 0 for none.

settings.name: Corner Rounding
settings.tip: How round the corners of the widgets, the pop-outs, their sections and the help bar are, wherever those are Set by Theme. Auto keeps the corners of the theme's own style. Default: Auto.

settings.name: Pop-out Opacity
settings.tip: How much of the game shows through the pop-outs. At 100% none of it does.

settings.name: Status Icons
settings.tip: The pictures of the status effects in the Status Timers widget and its pop-out: the game's own, or a pack's. A status a pack has no picture for shows the game's. Default: Vanilla.

settings.name: Show Status Background
settings.tip: Puts a buff's or a debuff's background behind each status icon. Default: off.

rows.name: Under Line
rows.tip: A row just under the border; clear for none.

rows.name: Glow Below
rows.tip: What fades out under the strip.

rows.name: Accent
rows.tip: Diamonds, frames, the pin mark and a lit widget.

rows.name: Accent End
rows.tip: What the accent runs into where it is a gradient.

rows.name: Pill
rows.tip: A widget's pill.

rows.name: Title
rows.tip: A widget's title on the strip.

rows.name: Subtitle
rows.tip: A widget's second line, and dim text in pop-outs.

rows.name: Divider
rows.tip: The diamonds between widgets on an ornate strip.

rows.name: Pop-out Top
rows.tip: A pop-out's color at its top.

rows.name: Pop-out Bottom
rows.tip: A pop-out's color at its foot.

rows.name: Pop-out Outer Border
rows.tip: A ring around an ornate pop-out's border; clear for none.

rows.name: Tag Fill
rows.tip: The small labels in pop-outs.

rows.name: Highlight
rows.tip: Over a widget under the pointer.

rows.name: Border Color
rows.tip: The line along the strip's foot.

cards.name: Nameplates
cards.description: Appearance settings for the HeadsUp entity nameplates. You can more deeply configure these per entity in the tabs on the left.

settings.name: Default Font
settings.tip: The default used by most other nameplate font settings.

settings.name: Base Font Size
settings.tip: The base font size for nameplate elements.

settings.name: Base Icon Size
settings.tip: The base icon size for nameplate elements.

settings.name: Linkpearl Outline
settings.tip: How thick the dark outline around a linkshell's pearl is: 100% is XIUI's, 0% none.

settings.name: Vertical Offset
settings.tip: Offsets the entire nameplate upward by this many pixels.

settings.name: Scale with Distance
settings.tip: Automatically scales nameplates based on distance to the player character.

settings.name: Min Scale
settings.tip: The minimum scale for the nameplate. This affects its size when far away.

settings.name: Max Size
settings.tip: The maximum scale for the nameplate. This affects its size when very close.

settings.name: Auto-Check
settings.tip: Automatically checks all nearby enemies to get their exact level and difficulty. Players are never checked: their level is read from what the server already sends, unless they are anonymous.

settings.name: Look Up Players
settings.tip: Asks the search server for the job and level of every player near you, as the friend list does; they are not told. Anonymous players stay hidden.

settings.name: Stack Names
settings.tip: If enabled, when nameplates would overlap, they instead stack on top of each other. NOTE: Your target's nameplate will be prioritized and stay in place.

settings.name: Show Line to Entity
settings.tip: When a name is stacked upward, draw a line from the bottom of the nameplate down to it's original position to indicate the player it is attached to.

settings.name: Hide During Conversation
settings.tip: Hides all nameplates, outlines and target cursors while you are in a conversation with an NPC or a cutscene.

cards.name: Nameplate Opacity
cards.description: Allows you to make nameplates more transparent under certain conditions.

settings.name: No Target
settings.tip: The opacity used for all nameplates whenever you currently have no target.

settings.name: Not Targeted
settings.tip: When you are targeting any entity, this is the opacity used for all nameplates of entities that are not your target.

settings.name: Is Targeted
settings.tip: The opacity used for any entity that you are currently targeting, regardless of distance.

settings.name: Fade In
settings.tip: If enabled, nameplates will fade in as you get closer. Does not apply to your current target.

settings.name: Max Range
settings.tip: At what range (in yalms) the nameplate will become fully transparent.

cards.name: Outline Style
cards.description: Appearance settings for the HeadsUp outlines, which gives entities colored borders. You can more deeply configure these per entity in the tabs on the left.

settings.name: Smoothness
settings.tip: Higher settings create rounder outlines at small cost to performance.

settings.name: Max Range
settings.tip: The maximum distance (in yalms) that outlines will be rendered.

settings.name: Fade In
settings.tip: If enabled, outlines will become more transparent the further you get from the entity.

settings.name: Outlines are unavailable: the depth buffer has no stencil bits.

cards.name: Target Cursor
cards.description: Appearance settings for the cursor that appears above the target entity.

settings.name: Cursor Style
settings.tip: What icon should be used for the target cursor? You can place custom images in the config/cursors folder and they will appear in the drop-down menu as options.

options.name: Vanilla
options.tip: Uses the vanilla target cursor. WARNING: May be invisible or flicker if the vanilla target frame is hidden by any addons.

options.name: Vanilla-like
options.tip: Uses a simple triangle target cursor, which looks similar to the vanilla target cursor.

options.name: Phoenix Feather
options.tip: Uses a phoenix feather icon as the target cursor.

options.name: Chocobo
options.tip: Uses the PlayOnline chocobo mouse pointer as the target cursor.
Uses a custom icon as the target cursor.

settings.name: Outline Thickness
settings.tip: The thickness of the target cursor's outline.

settings.name: Vertical Offset
settings.tip: Offsets the target cursor upward by this many pixels.

settings.name: Color
settings.tip: Determines the color of the target cursor.

settings.name: Outline Color
settings.tip: Determines the color of the target cursor's outline.

settings.name: Scale with Distance
settings.tip: Automatically scales the target cursor based on distance to the player character.

settings.name: Floating Cursor
settings.tip: If enabled, the target cursor will bob gently up and down.

cards.name: Panel Appearance
cards.description: Hover a widget for details; click it to keep them open. Its cog opens its options.

settings.name: Show Separator
settings.tip: Where the top panel shows its separators, whatever the theme. Separator Style on the Theme page picks their shape. Default: Between Widgets and End Caps.

options.name: Never
options.tip: No separators. Picking it clears the others.

options.name: Between Widgets
options.tip: A separator between each widget and the next.

options.name: End Caps
options.tip: A separator at the far left and far right of the top panel.

settings.name: Panel Height
settings.tip: How tall the top panel is. The text and icons of every widget grow and shrink with it.

settings.name: Widget Spacing
settings.tip: More room between every widget and the widgets beside it. Default: 0 px.

settings.name: Hide Server Info
settings.tip: The game's S, R and % numbers at the top right.

settings.name: Shift Vanilla UI
settings.tip: Shifts base game UI elements downward that would otherwise be partially hidden by the top bar. NOTE: UI elements that are manually positioned or hidden in the User Interface tab will be ignored.

cards.name: Widget Layout
cards.description: Drag a widget to move it, and click one that is on to open its settings in its pop-out on the top panel. Click it again to close them. Its toggle turns it on and off. You can also open a widget's settings from the cog in its pop-out.

cards.name: Widget Appearance
cards.description: How every widget on the top panel looks.

settings.name: Padding
settings.tip: The room inside every widget, from its edges to its text. Default: the theme's own.

settings.name: Icon Scale
settings.tip: The size of the icons in widgets. At 100% an icon is as tall as its widget can hold. Default: 65%.

settings.name: Show Background
settings.tip: Shows every widget's box even when the pointer is not on it, on top of what the theme gives it. Default: Off.

settings.name: Primary Font
settings.tip: The font of each widget's top line, of a widget on one line, and of the pop-outs' headings. Default: the theme's.

settings.name: Secondary Font
settings.tip: The font of each widget's second line, its numbers and the pop-outs' text. Default: the theme's.

settings.name: Font Size Ratio
settings.tip: Ratio of the size of the primary line's text to the size of the secondary line's text. At 1 both lines are the same size; above 1 the secondary line is smaller. Both lines grow or shrink together to fit the Panel Height. Default: 1.20x.

settings.name: Corner Rounding
settings.tip: How round the corners of the widgets' backgrounds are. Set by Theme keeps the theme's own. Default: Set by Theme.

cards.name: Pop-out Appearance
cards.description: How the widgets' pop-outs look.

settings.name: Text Scale
settings.tip: Makes the text in the pop-outs larger or smaller. At 1x a pop-out's title is 18 px, its section titles 16 px and its text 14 px. Default: 1.0x.

settings.name: Width
settings.tip: Makes each pop-out and its sections wider, without changing the text. Default: 1.0x.

settings.name: Height
settings.tip: Makes each pop-out and its sections taller, without changing the text. Default: 1.0x.

settings.name: Pop-out Rounding
settings.tip: How round the corners of the pop-outs are. Set by Theme keeps the theme's own. Default: Set by Theme.

settings.name: Section Rounding
settings.tip: How round the corners of the sections in the pop-outs are. Set by Theme keeps the theme's own. Default: Set by Theme.

cards.name: Widgets
cards.description: Each widget's settings, in its pop-out on the top panel.

rows.name: Widget Designer
rows.tip: Use the lines below to set what info from this widget is shown in the top bar, along with how it is organized.

rows.name: Icon
rows.tip: Where the widget's icon shows: before its text, after it, or not at all. Default is Show on Left.

rows.name: Alignment
rows.tip: Puts the widget's content against the left or right of its pill, or in its middle. Set by Location lines it up with the side of the panel it is on. Default is Set by Location.

rows.name: Show Zone ID in Header
rows.tip: The zone's number after its name at the top of the pop-out, as in Valkurm Dunes (Zone #103). Default is on.

rows.name: Link Widget
rows.tip: Merges this widget with the selected widget to show their content in a single pill and pop-out. Default is None.

rows.name: Linked Padding
rows.tip: The space between this widget and the one it is linked to. Default is 0 px.

rows.name: Visibility
rows.tip: The kinds of target the widget shows for. With one left out, the widget hides while you target one. Default is all of them.

rows.name: Detection Icons
rows.tip: Which of a mob's icons the Detection part shows. Default is all of them.

rows.name: Blue Magic
rows.tip: In the pop-out, a mob's TP moves that a blue mage can learn are shown in the Blue Magic Color. Default is on.

rows.name: Blue Magic Color
rows.tip: The color of TP moves a blue mage can learn. Default is blue.

rows.name: Learned Blue Magic
rows.tip: How a TP move whose blue magic you already know is shown: still blue with a star after it, or as plain text. Default is Star.

rows.name: Currency 1
rows.tip: The currency the widget's Currency 1 buttons show. Default is Gil.

rows.name: Currency 2
rows.tip: The currency the widget's Currency 2 buttons show. Default is Conquest Points, your nation's.

rows.name: Use Custom Icons
rows.tip: When the widget and its pop-out show HeadsUp's own weather pictures in place of the game's element icons. Default is Always.

rows.name: Tracked Ship
rows.tip: The boat or airship whose next sailing the Ship button shows.

rows.name: Tracked Guild
rows.tip: The guild shop whose hours the Guild button shows.

rows.name: Bag
rows.tip: The bag this widget shows on the panel. Hover it for every bag.

rows.name: Local Timezone
rows.tip: The zone of the Local Time button. Automatic is your computer's. Another zone goes before the time, as in PDT 21:07. Default is Automatic.

rows.name: Secondary Timezone
rows.tip: The zone of the Secondary Timezone button, which goes before its time, as in JST 13:07. Default is Japan (JST), the server's time, which the daily reset and the conquest tally go by.

rows.name: Seconds
rows.tip: Adds seconds to the Local Time button and to the time in the pop-out's title.

rows.name: Date Format
rows.tip: How the Local Date button writes the date. Default is MM/DD/YYYY.

rows.name: Job Names
rows.tip: Off, the levels alone.

rows.name: Bar Width
rows.tip: How long the EXP Bar is. Default is 100 px.

rows.name: Bar Height
rows.tip: How thick the EXP Bar is. Default is 6 px.

rows.name: Bar Text
rows.tip: What the EXP Bar shows on it. Default is None.

rows.name: Bar Text Alignment
rows.tip: Puts the EXP Bar's text at its left or right end, or in its middle. Default is Center.

rows.name: Show Mem Text
rows.tip: Puts "Mem" before the Memory button's figures. Off, the figures alone. Default is off.

rows.name: Display
rows.tip: What shows for each pinned status: its name, its icon, or both with the icon first. Default is Both Name & Icon.

rows.name: Job Text
rows.tip: How Job Info and the EXP Bar's Job Text write your jobs and levels. Default is Main 75 / Sub 37.

words.name: Clone This Widget
words.tip: Puts another of this widget on the panel after it, with all of this one's settings.

words.name: Remove This Copy
words.tip: Takes this copy off the panel. Its settings go with it.

words.name: At least one button must be enabled.
Use the lines below to change how info is organized in the widget.

settings.name: Cursor Icon
settings.tip: What the mouse cursor looks like. You can place cursor files in the config/headsup/cursors folder and they will appear in the drop-down menu as options.

options.name: Vanilla
options.tip: Changes nothing about the mouse cursor, keeping its vanilla appearance.

options.name: Chocobo
options.tip: Replaces the mouse cursor with the Chocobo cursor from PlayOnline.
Replaces the mouse cursor with this file from the config/headsup/cursors folder.

settings.name: Cursor Size
settings.tip: How large the mouse cursor is, the game's own included.

settings.name: Pointer Fix
settings.tip: Keeps the game's pointer under yours after a resize, and clicks where you click. It also shows the pointer again over Ashita's windows.

settings.name: Keep Pointer
settings.tip: The game hides its pointer when a key runs a command. While only these keys are held, it stays.

settings.name: Lock Cursor to Window
settings.tip: While the game has the focus, the mouse cursor can not leave its window. Default is off.

cards.name: Screenshot Mode
cards.description: Every name, the top panel and every addon window go, as with /hu screenshot. Ashita's /screenshot hide turns it on by itself for its picture.

settings.name: Key
settings.tip: Turns screenshot mode on and off. The game sees the key too, so pick one it does not use.

settings.name: Hide Game Windows
settings.tip: The game's own windows and chat go too.

cards.name: Appearance
cards.description: The game's help text, in a bar of its own under the top panel.

settings.name: Hide Game Help
settings.tip: The game's own help bar, which the top panel covers.

settings.name: Position
settings.tip: Pixels from its place under the top panel.

settings.name: Background
settings.tip: Off, the help text alone, with no bar behind it.

settings.name: Corner Rounding
settings.tip: How round the help bar's corners are. Set by Theme keeps the theme's own. Default: Set by Theme.

settings.name: Font Size
settings.tip: The size of the help text. Auto uses the top panel's title size. Default: Auto.

settings.name: Anchor
settings.tip: Which side of the screen the help bar keeps to. Its text lines up the same way inside it. Default: Left.

options.name: Left
options.tip: Against the screen's left edge, with its text on the left.

options.name: Center
options.tip: In the middle of the screen, with its text centered.

options.name: Right
options.tip: Against the screen's right edge, with its text on the right.

settings.name: Full Width
settings.tip: The help bar takes the screen's whole width, however short its text. Default: Off.

settings.name: Width
settings.tip: How much of the screen's width the help bar can take. Longer help is cut and shows in full when you hover it. Default: 50%.

settings.name: Height
settings.tip: How tall the help bar is. Auto fits it to its text. Default: Auto.

cards.name: Appearance
cards.description: HeadsUp's own bar of a hooked fish's stamina. It keeps working when you hide the party window, where the game draws its own.

settings.name: Fishing Bar
settings.tip: Which bar shows the fish's stamina while you fight it. Default: HeadsUp Fish Stamina.

options.name: Hide Fish Stamina
options.tip: Hides the game's fish stamina bar and shows no bar of HeadsUp's.

options.name: Vanilla Fish Stamina
options.tip: Keeps the game's own fish stamina bar and shows no bar of HeadsUp's.

options.name: HeadsUp Fish Stamina
options.tip: Hides the game's fish stamina bar and shows HeadsUp's in its place. It shows only while a fish is hooked: drag it where you want it then.

settings.name: Width
settings.tip: How wide the fishing bar is.

settings.name: Height
settings.tip: How tall the fishing bar is, its frame counted. Default: 18 px.

settings.name: X Position
settings.tip: Pixels from the left of the screen to the bar. Auto centers it. Default: Auto.

settings.name: Y Position
settings.tip: Pixels from the top of the screen to the bar. Auto puts it low on the screen. Default: Auto.

settings.name: Draggable
settings.tip: On, you can drag the bar to move it while a fish is hooked. Off, clicks go through it to the game. Default: On.

settings.name: Font
settings.tip: The font of the text over the bar. Default: the top panel's Secondary Font.

settings.name: Font Size
settings.tip: The size of the text over the bar. Default: 15 px.

settings.name: Text
settings.tip: What the text over the bar says. Drag the buttons below into it, and write your own text around them. HeadsUp only says what the game has told you, never which fish it is.

settings.name: Color by Catch
settings.tip: Colors the bar by what is on the line. A rod that could break comes first, then a line that could snap, then the size of the catch. Off, the bar keeps the theme's color. Default: On.

settings.name: Small Fish
settings.tip: The bar's color for a small fish.

settings.name: Large Fish
settings.tip: The bar's color for a large fish.

settings.name: Item
settings.tip: The bar's color for an item.

settings.name: Monster
settings.tip: The bar's color for a monster. Default: purple.

settings.name: Line Break
settings.tip: The bar's color when your line could snap, which the game warns of with a bad feeling. Default: orange.

settings.name: Rod Break
settings.tip: The bar's color when your rod could break, which the game warns of with a terrible feeling. Default: red.

pages.name: Vanilla UI
pages.description: NOTE: These settings are a work in progress and for advanced users only.

settings.name: Game Help
settings.tip: The game's own help bar goes under the top panel, and the windows under it. Off while it is hidden.

settings.name: Auto Adjust Windows
settings.tip: Places every menu's windows right under the top panel as it is now, for the game help on and off. Your own shifts go.

words.name: HeadsUp Defaults
words.tip: Every menu's windows under the top panel as HeadsUp places them. Your shifts and places are cleared.

words.name: HeadsUp Help
words.tip: HeadsUp's help text in place of the game's help bar, which is hidden, and the windows as HeadsUp places them.

words.name: Game Defaults
words.tip: Every window where the game puts it: nothing moved, no places of your own.

words.name: X and Y put a window at a place of your own on the screen, in the game's menu pixels from the top left; a window you place is not shifted. Type a number, then Enter; the arrow lets it go.

words.tip: Every window the game has, not only the named ones and yours.
Keep draws it as the game does, at the X and Y you give it; Hide draws nothing of it and lets no click through to it. Its keys still work, so Escape closes a hidden menu.

words.name: The windows each menu opens move together by one shift, so they keep their places beside each other. Your own shift replaces the default, which brings the menu's highest window to Windows Start At. Type a number, then Enter.
Game Help On
words.tip: The shifts while the game's help shows under the top panel: its help line, or the game's own help bar.

words.name: Game Help Off
words.tip: The shifts while no help shows under the top panel.

words.name: Windows Start At
words.tip: Where each menu's highest window goes, in the game's menu pixels from the top of the screen.
Its shift down from where the game puts its windows, up when below zero.

cards.name: Aggression
cards.description: Colors indicating a mob's level of aggression towards you, as well as their status as a notorious monster (or placeholder for a notorious monster).

cards.name: Toughness
cards.description: Colors indicating how difficult a mob is at your current level.

cards.name: Claim Status
cards.description: Colors indicating whether or not a mob is claimed and by whom.

rows.name: Called for Help
rows.tip: Used when the mob is engaged in combat and the player who claimed it has used the 'Call for Help' feature, allowing anyone to attack it.

cards.name: Targeting
cards.description: Colors indicating your targeting and lock-on status for the entity.

rows.name: Sub-Target
rows.tip: Used when switching targets or choosing a target for your spells and abilities.

rows.name: Out of Range
rows.tip: Used when sub-targeting and the target is out of range.

cards.name: Entity Type
cards.description: Colors indicating the type of entity and their relation to the player.

rows.name: Linkshell Member
rows.tip: A member of the same linkshell as you.

cards.name: Profiles
cards.description: Each character uses a profile of settings, made from your settings the first time they log in. Characters can share a profile: a change on one shows on the other.

settings.name: Save Automatically
settings.tip: Saves every change to your profile as you make it. Turn it off to try settings out: changes then last until you press Save, and Revert puts back what was saved. Default is on.

settings.name: Unsaved Changes
settings.tip: With Save Automatically off: Save writes your changes to the profile. Unsaved changes are lost when HeadsUp unloads, the game closes or you switch profile.

words.name: Revert
words.tip: Puts back the settings as they were last saved.

words.name: Profile
words.tip: The profiles in config/headsup/profiles. The one this character uses has a star.

words.name: Use
words.tip: This character uses the profile picked from now on. Your settings are saved to the one in use first.

words.name: Delete
words.tip: Deletes the profile picked. The one in use cannot be deleted. A character that used it makes a new one at its next login.

words.name: New Profile
words.tip: Create makes a profile of this name from your settings now, which this character then uses. Rename gives the profile in use this name, for every character that uses it.

words.name: Rename
words.tip: Gives the profile in use this name, for every character that uses it.

settings.name: Enable HeadsUp
settings.tip: If turned off, all HeadsUp features will be disabled.

settings.name: Font
settings.tip: The font used for this config window.

settings.name: Font Size
settings.tip: The font size used for this config window, in pixels.

settings.name: Window Opacity
settings.tip: The opacity of this config window.

settings.name: Generate Report
settings.tip: As /hu debug: writes a report to logs/headsup.

words.name: Start Watching
words.tip: As /hu drawdump watch: watches every frame for names that jump, flicker or vanish, and writes what it finds to logs/headsup until stopped.

settings.name: Logging
settings.tip: Writes what HeadsUp works around to logs/headsup, where chat only gets what stops working.

settings.name: Reset All Settings
settings.tip: Every setting on every page back to its default.

words.name: Every setting goes back to its default. This cannot be undone.

cards.name: Feedback
cards.description: Have any suggestions for improvements, new features, or bugs to report? Let us know!

settings.name: Type
settings.tip: What kind of feedback you are sending.

settings.name: Topic
settings.tip: The part of HeadsUp it is about. With Other, say what in the box beside it.

settings.name: Send Feedback
settings.tip: Sends the HeadsUp team what you wrote, its type and topic, and your version of HeadsUp. Nothing else about you or your game is sent.

words.name: You must fill out all fields in order to send your feedback.
Sent. Thank you for your feedback!
Your feedback could not be sent. Please try again later.

cards.name: Visible When
cards.description: Settings determining in what context the HeadsUp nameplates and outlines are shown or hidden.

rows.name: Aggressive Mobs
rows.tip: Applies only when the mob would attack you. So, mobs that are Too Weak will be considered passive.

rows.name: Passive Mobs
rows.tip: Mobs that won't attack you, including Too Weak mobs that would normally be aggressive.

rows.name: NM (Aggressive)
rows.tip: Notorious monsters that would attack you.

rows.name: NM (Passive)
rows.tip: Notorious monsters that would not attack you.

rows.name: NM (Placeholder)
rows.tip: When an NM placeholder dies, there is a chance that an NM will spawn. This separate setting allows you to make these placeholder mobs clearly indicated.

rows.name: Claimed (Yours)
rows.tip: A mob that is claimed by you (or your party).

rows.name: Claimed (Others')
rows.tip: A mob that is claimed, but by another player outside of your party.

rows.name: No Data
rows.tip: Mobs whose information is unknown.

rows.name: Players
rows.tip: All players with no relation to you.

rows.name: Party Members
rows.tip: Players that are part of your current party.

rows.name: Friends
rows.tip: Players that are on your friends list (and not in your party).

rows.name: Linkshell Members
rows.tip: Players that are in the same linkshell as you (and are not your friend or in your party). NOTE: A player's linkshell is only known once you /check them.

rows.name: Self
rows.tip: Settings for your own character's nameplate and outline.

rows.name: Your Pets
rows.tip: Apply to only your own pet.

rows.name: Party Pets
rows.tip: Apply to pets owned by your party members.

rows.name: Friend Pets
rows.tip: Apply to pets owned by your friends.

rows.name: Others' Pets
rows.tip: Apply to all other pets.

cards.name: Outline Design
cards.description: For each type of entity that has an outline enabled, you can choose how you want it to be colored.

settings.tip: For this entity type, choose between a custom color and automated coloring based on the entity's state.

cards.name: Nameplate Design
cards.description:
Choose what information is displayed on this entity's nameplate, and how it is displayed.

- Drag buttons from the selection area into each line.
- Placing a button on top of another one merges them, making it choose which one to display automatically.
- Write your own text between and around buttons as needed.

words.tip: Swaps this line with the one above it: its text and its whole Line Style.
Swaps this line with the one below it: its text and its whole Line Style.

settings.name: Max Icons Shown
settings.tip: The maximum number of icons that can be displayed.

cards.name: Line Style
cards.description: These are settings to change the appearance of each line individually.

rows.name: Sync Line Style
rows.tip: Causes this line to use the same appearance settings as another line.

rows.name: Line Visibility
rows.tip: Determines in what contexts this line is visible.

rows.name: Alignment
rows.tip: The horizontal alignment of text and icons in this line.

rows.name: Text Size
rows.tip: A percentage of the base font size set in the Nameplates & Outlines/Nameplates section.

rows.name: Icon Size
rows.tip: A percentage of the icon font size set in the Nameplates & Outlines/Nameplates section.

rows.name: Padding
rows.tip: Adds extra space between this line and the one below it.
rows.tipBottomLine: Adds extra space between this line and the ones above it.

rows.name: Horizontal Offset
rows.tip: Moves this line left or right from where its alignment puts it. The other lines stay where they are.

rows.name: Text Color
rows.tip: The color of text on this line. Can be custom, or it can be automatically colored based on the entity's state.

rows.name: Shadow Strength
rows.tip: The strength of a shadow drawn behind the text to make it more readable. If set to 0%, the shadow is disabled.

rows.name: Glow Strength
rows.tip: A strength of a colored glow behind and around the text on this line. If set to 0%, the glow is disabled.

rows.name: Glow Size
rows.tip: How far from the text the glow extends.

rows.name: Glow Color
rows.tip: The color of the glow.

rows.name: Disable Glow In Combat
rows.tip: No glow on this line while you are in combat: your weapon is out, or a mob is claimed by you or your party.

words.name: Do Not Sync
words.tip: Line style is not synced, meaning it has its own unique appearance.

words.name: Sync with {line}
words.tip: Forces this line to use the same appearance settings as defined for the {line}.

cards.name: Ornament
cards.description: Adds a decorative horizontal divider between two of the lines.

rows.name: Visibility
rows.tip: Location of the ornament, if anywhere.

rows.name: Width
rows.tip: The width of the divider.

rows.name: Height
rows.tip: The height of the divider's diamond.

rows.name: Color
rows.tip: The divider's color.

cards.name: Detection Icons
cards.description: Settings that determine which MobDB icons will be included when the Detection tag is part of the nameplate.

rows.name: Aggression
rows.tip: An icon indicating whether the mob is aggressive or passive.

rows.name: Links
rows.tip: An icon indicating that the mob will attack you if you are currently in combat with the same kind of mob.

rows.name: Sight
rows.tip: An icon indicating that the mob can detect you by sight.

rows.name: True Sight
rows.tip: An icon indicating that the mob has true sight and thus can detect you even if you are invisible and sneaking.

rows.name: Sound
rows.tip: An icon indicating that the mob can detect you by sound.

rows.name: Scent
rows.tip: An icon indicating that the mob can detect you by smell.

rows.name: Use of Spells
rows.tip: An icon indicating that the mob might attack you if it sees you casting a spell.

rows.name: Use of Abilities
rows.tip: An icon indicating that the mob might attack you if it sees you using an ability.

rows.name: Low Player HP
rows.tip: An icon indicating that the mob might attack you if your health is too low.

cards.name: Badge Text
cards.description: Settings that adjust the text included with Weakness, Resistances, Status and Immunity icons. Also used by the target widget.

settings.name: Badge Numbers
settings.tip: What the badge of a weakness or resistance by rank says. A rank changes the mob's magic evasion, so it changes how often magic lands, not how hard it hits.

options.name: Rank
options.tip: Phoenix's rank, -3 to 11.

options.name: Increased Chance
options.tip: How much more often magic lands than on a mob without the weakness, or how much less often with a resistance.

options.name: Total Chance
options.tip: How often your spell lands: an unresisted tier I nuke for an element, the effect for a status, from your level, skill, stats and gear against the mob's.

settings.name: Count Your Accuracy
settings.tip: Increased Chance from your own magic accuracy, so it shrinks once you land 95% of the time anyway. Off, it is the magic evasion the rank takes away or adds alone.

settings.name: Weakness Color
settings.tip: The color used for badge text with Weakness icons.

settings.name: Resistance Color
settings.tip: The color used for badge text with Resistance icons.

settings.name: Status Resist Color
settings.tip: The color used for badge text with Status icons.

settings.name: Immunity Color
settings.tip: The color used for badge text with Immunity icons.

cards.name: Weaknesses
cards.description: Allows you to set which elements are included in Weakness and Resistance icons.

settings.name: Weak From
settings.tip: The minimum weakness for which a badge is displayed.

settings.name: Resist From
settings.tip: The minimum resistance for which a badge is displayed.

settings.name: Max Elements
settings.tip: The maximum number of element icons that can be shown.

words.name: None
words.tip: No element badges.

words.name: All
words.tip: Every element past the cutoffs.
The {count} elements farthest from neutral.

cards.name: Statuses
cards.description: Allows you to set which statuses are included in the Status resistance icons.

cards.name: NM Placeholder Timers
cards.description: Some enemies are placeholders for a notorious monster. When they die, the notorious monster has a chance to spawn. These settings allow you to see a timer for the next possible spawn.

settings.name: Respawn Timer
settings.tip: If enabled, it shows a timer until the next possible spawn when an NM or its placeholder dies within 50 yalms of you, if you took part: you targeted it, or you were active (moved or turned in the last 2:30) while it was on your screen. Phoenix's rule, so standing AFK earns no timers. If the NM or placeholder is up, it reads 'Up'.

settings.name: Timer Size
settings.tip: The font size of the timer text, as a multiplier of the base font size set by the Nameplates & Outlines/Nameplates section.

settings.name: Up Time
settings.tip: How long a timer stays, reading 'Up', once the NM or its placeholder can spawn. Then it goes. At 0 it goes as soon as it is up. Default is 5 minutes.

options.name: Hide Nameplate
options.tip: Shows no nameplate at all for this entity.

options.name: Show Nameplate
options.tip: Shows a HeadsUp nameplate above this entity.

options.name: When Targeted
options.tip: Uses a HeadsUp nameplate above the entity if targeted. Otherwise, no nameplate is shown.

options.name: Vanilla Nameplate
options.tip: Shows the base game (vanilla) nameplate for this entity.

options.name: No Outline
options.tip: Disables the HeadsUp outline feature for this entity.

options.name: Show Outline
options.tip: Draws an outline around the entity's model.

options.name: When Targeted
options.tip: Draws an outline around the entity's model, but only when the entity is your current target.

options.name: Inherit
options.tip: Uses the same outline setting as determined by the mob's aggression.
options.tipOnClaimRows: Uses the same outline setting as when the mob is unclaimed.

options.name: Custom
options.tip: Set this to be any static color of your choice.

options.name: Vanilla Color
options.tip: Use the same color as used by the base game.

options.name: By Aggression
options.tip: Automatically changes the color based on whether the mob is passive, aggressive or an NM. (Set these colors in the 'Colors/Aggression' section.)

options.name: By Toughness
options.tip: Automatically changes the color based on how tough the mob is at your current level. (Set these colors in the 'Colors/Toughness' section.)

options.name: By Claim Status
options.tip: Automatically changes the color based on whether the enemy is claimed and by whom. (Set these colors in the 'Colors/Claim Status' section.)

options.name: By Targeting
options.tip: Automatically changes the color based on whether you are targeting the entity, locked on, sub-targeting, etc. (Set these colors in the 'Colors/Targeting' section.)

options.name: By Entity Type
options.tip: Automatically changes the color based on the type of entity and their relation to you. (Set these colors in the 'Colors/Entity Type' section.)

options.name: Targeted
options.tip: Visible while the entity is your current target.

options.name: Unclaimed
options.tip: Visible while the mob is not claimed by anyone.

options.name: Claimed (Yours)
options.tip: Visible while the mob is claimed by you (or your party).

options.name: Claimed (Others)
options.tip: Visible while the mob is claimed by other players.

options.name: Engaged in Combat
options.tip: Visible while you are currently in combat with any mob.

options.name: Too Weak
options.tip: Visible even if the entity is considered 'Too Weak'.

options.name: Aggressive
options.tip: Visible when the mob is aggressive (and thus would attack you).

options.name: Passive
options.tip: Visible when the mob is passive (and thus would not attack you).

options.name: Party Member
options.tip: Visible when the entity is a party member.

options.name: Friend
options.tip: Visible when the entity is a friend.

options.name: Linkshell Member
options.tip: Visible when the entity is a member of your linkshell.

options.name: You Are Owner
options.tip: Visible even if the owner of the pet is you.

options.name: Generally
options.tip: Visible generally, when other conditions below do not apply.

options.name: Disabled
options.tip: Ornament is disabled, and not shown at all.

options.name: Top
options.tip: Shown at the top of the nameplate.

options.name: Above Middle Line
options.tip: Shown between the middle line and the top line.

options.name: Below Middle Line
options.tip: Shown between the middle line and the bottom line.

options.name: Bottom
options.tip: Shown at the very bottom, beneath the nameplate.

options.name: Phoenix Gold
options.tip: An ornate strip in dark brown and gold, with diamonds between its widgets.

options.name: Umbra Dark
options.tip: Each widget in a grey pill, lit in blue.

options.name: Phoenix Red
options.tip: The ornate strip in Phoenix's dark red.

options.name: Aurora
options.tip: Slate glass, lit from cyan into violet.

options.name: Custom
options.tip: One of your own themes, from the Customize Appearance card.

options.name: Vanilla
options.tip: The game's own window art, of the Window Type the game is set to, in colors taken from it.

options.name: Zone
options.tip: The zone, its region and who holds it. Hover for the influence there and the conquest tally.

options.name: Forecast
options.tip: The weather now and Vana'diel's date, day, time and moon. Hover for today, the forecast, and the zones that can roll each element today and tomorrow.

options.name: Target
options.tip: Your target's name, level and con. Hover a mob for its details.

options.name: Currency
options.tip: Gil, or another currency. Hover for your favorite currencies and every other one, with a star to keep one at the top.

options.name: Inventory
options.tip: How full your inventory is. Hover for every bag.

options.name: Clock
options.tip: Your computer's time or another time zone's, with a second zone's time or Vana'diel's if you like. Hover for the daily reset and conquest tally.

options.name: Game Help
options.tip: The game's help text, in a bar of its own under the top panel.

options.name: Performance
options.tip: Frames per second, bytes sent and received each second and the game's memory, as you pick. Amber or red when data stops or memory runs low. Hover for the last server data, PlayOnline messages, the processor, the frames and the LinuxXI plugin's figures.

options.name: Job & EXP
options.tip: Jobs, levels and EXP to the next level, with a bar. Hover for EXP per hour.

options.name: Party
options.tip: Party size and the lowest HP and MP. Hover for each member.

options.name: Status Timers
options.tip: The time left on each status you pin. Hover for your favorite statuses, with a pin to show one here, and every other status with a star to add it to them.

options.name: World Info
options.tip: The next ship, a weather, a guild's hours, the RSE, the moon or how many regions each nation holds, as you pick. Hover for every ship, the guilds with today's turn-ins from Phoenix's website, the calendar and each nation's regions.

options.name: Settings
options.tip: Just the settings cog. Click it to open these settings on the Top Panel page, at Widget Layout.

options.name: Main 75 / Sub 37
options.tip: Your main job and its level, then your subjob and its level.

options.name: Main 75
options.tip: Your main job and its level.

options.name: 75 Main / Sub
options.tip: Your main job's level, then your main job and subjob.

options.name: None
options.tip: Nothing on the bar.

options.name: Earned EXP
options.tip: The EXP you have of this level, out of what it takes. At the level cap, your limit points.

options.name: EXP Til Next Level
options.tip: The EXP left to the next level. At the level cap, your merits.

options.name: EXP Percentage
options.tip: How much of the level you have, as a percent.

options.name: Job Text
options.tip: Your jobs and levels, as Job Text writes them.

options.name: Name
options.tip: The name of the entity.

options.name: Level
options.tip: Shows the entity's current level. NOTE: For mobs, this will show a range until you /check the mob. You can also enable the Auto-Check feature in the 'Nameplates & Outlines/Nameplates' section. For players, this shows once you /check them, or with the Auto-Check feature on once the server has sent it (it does when you come upon them, not when they arrive beside you), unless they are anonymous.

options.name: Difficulty
options.tip: Shows initials indicating the mob's difficulty for your current level (TW for Too Weak, EP for Easy Prey, and so on). NOTE: Shows a range of possibilities until you /check the mob, unless you have the Auto-Check feature enabled in the 'Nameplates & Outlines/Nameplates' section.

options.name: ID
options.tip: The last three hex digits of the mob's ID. Example: [106].

options.name: Server ID
options.tip: The mob's full server ID in decimal. Example: [17190918].

options.name: Placeholder
options.tip: If the mob is a placeholder for a notorious monster, this shows [PH]. Otherwise, it shows nothing.

options.name: Detection
options.tip: Shows icons representing the mob's aggression and detection modes (eg Sight, Sound, True Sight, etc).

options.name: Weaknesses
options.tip: Shows icons representing the mob's weaknesses, along with percentages or ranks.

options.name: Resistances
options.tip: Shows icons representing the mob's resistances, along with percentages or ranks.

options.name: Statuses
options.tip: Shows icons representing the statuses that the mob is weak or resistant to, along with percentages or ranks.

options.name: Immunities
options.tip: Shows icons representing things the mob is completely immune to.

options.name: GM
options.tip: Shows an icon indicating that the player is a GM (Game Manager).

options.name: Mentor
options.tip: Shows an icon indicating that the user is a Mentor.

options.name: New Adventurer
options.tip: Shows an icon indicating the user may be new to the game.

options.name: Level Sync
options.tip: Shows an icon indicating the player's level is currently synced.

options.name: Away
options.tip: Shows an icon indicating that the user is away from their keyboard (or at least that they have not moved or taken any action in a while).

options.name: Linkshell
options.tip: Shows an icon representing the player's equipped linkshell.

options.name: Bazaar
options.tip: Shows an icon indicating the player is selling items in their bazaar.

options.name: Seeking Party
options.tip: Shows an icon indicating the player is looking to join a party.

options.name: Job
options.tip: Shows the player's job and subjob (example: WAR/NIN). NOTE: Only shows after you use /check on the player.

options.name: Owner
options.tip: Shows the name of the pet's owner.

options.name: Title
options.tip: Shows the player's title. NOTE: Only shows after you use /check on the player.

options.name: Job & Level
options.tip: Shows each job after its level, such as 75 WAR / 37 NIN. A level not known yet is left out (75 WAR / NIN). If only the level is known, it shows Level 75. If neither is known, it shows nothing.

options.name: Subjob Level
options.tip: Shows the level of the player's subjob (example: 37) once HeadsUp knows it: from your party, a check, or Look Up Players. Put it after Job to read as WAR/NIN 37.

options.name: Fish
options.tip: The word Fish.

options.name: Size
options.tip: What is on the line, as the game tells you when it bites: Small Fish, Large Fish, Item or Monster.

options.name: Feeling
options.tip: How the game says it feels about the catch, such as Good Feeling, Bad Feeling, Terrible Feeling, Low Skill or Epic Catch.

options.name: Line Break
options.tip: Shows Line Break when your line could snap. The game warns of this only with a bad feeling.

options.name: Rod Break
options.tip: Shows Rod Break when your rod could break. The game warns of this only with a terrible feeling.

options.name: Line Break
options.tip: Puts what follows on a row of its own under the rest of the line, in the line's own style. Press Enter in a line to make one.

options.name: Phoenix Gold
options.tip: Gold on dark, with Phoenix's feather.

options.name: Umbra Dark
options.tip: Plain and dark.

options.name: Phoenix Red
options.tip: Phoenix red with ornate edges.

options.name: Aurora
options.tip: Glass with a line of light under it.

options.name: Vanilla
options.tip: The art of the game's own windows.

options.name: Full
options.tip: Every mob shows a full nameplate, and mobs that will attack you get an outline. Players, you and NPCs show HeadsUp nameplates. This is the default.

options.name: Simple
options.tip: Mobs that will attack you show their level, con and name, with an outline. Other mobs show one when you target them. You have no nameplate.

options.name: Minimal
options.tip: Only your target shows a nameplate and an outline, with just its name. Players, NPCs and pets keep the game's own names.

options.name: All Mobs
options.tip: Every mob shows a HeadsUp nameplate.

options.name: Mobs That Attack
options.tip: Mobs that will attack you, NMs, placeholders and claimed mobs show one. Other mobs show one when you target them.

options.name: Only Your Target
options.tip: A mob shows a nameplate only while you target it.

options.name: Game's Names
options.tip: Mobs keep the game's own names.

options.name: Full
options.tip: Detection icons, then the level and con, then the name.

options.name: Simple
options.tip: The level and con over the name.

options.name: Name Only
options.tip: Just the name.

options.name: Mobs That Attack
options.tip: Outlines mobs that will attack you, NMs and placeholders.

options.name: Every Mob
options.tip: Outlines every living mob.

options.name: Only Your Target
options.tip: Outlines a mob only while you target it.

options.name: None
options.tip: No outlines. You can turn them back on in the settings window.

options.name: Thin
options.tip: Half the normal width.

options.name: Normal
options.tip: The default width.

options.name: Thick
options.tip: Twice the normal width.

options.name: Phoenix Feather
options.tip: Phoenix's feather over your target.

options.name: Arrow
options.tip: An arrow over your target.

options.name: Chocobo
options.tip: A chocobo over your target.

options.name: Game's Cursor
options.tip: Keeps the game's own target arrow.

options.name: HeadsUp's Nameplates
options.tip: Players show HeadsUp nameplates, with their status icons.

options.name: Game's Names
options.tip: Players keep the game's own names.

options.name: Show
options.tip: Your own nameplate is drawn by HeadsUp.

options.name: Hide
options.tip: You have no nameplate.

options.name: Game's Name
options.tip: You keep the game's own name.

options.name: Left of the Name
options.tip: The icons sit on the name's line, before the name. This is the default.

options.name: Right of the Name
options.tip: The icons sit on the name's line, after the name.

options.name: Above the Name
options.tip: The icons get a line of their own, just above the name.

options.name: HeadsUp's Nameplates
options.tip: NPCs show HeadsUp nameplates.

options.name: Game's Names
options.tip: NPCs keep the game's own names.

options.name: When Targeted
options.tip: A pet shows a nameplate while you target it.

options.name: Always
options.tip: Pets always show a nameplate.

options.name: Game's Names
options.tip: Pets keep the game's own names.

options.name: Full
options.tip: The zone, weather, both clocks, your job, target, gil and inventory, your frame rate, connection, distance and the game's help line.

options.name: Simple
options.tip: The zone, the weather with Vana'diel's time, your job, target, gil and inventory.

options.name: Minimal
options.tip: The zone, the weather with Vana'diel's time, and your target.

options.name: No Top Panel
options.tip: No Top Panel. You can turn it on again in the settings window.

options.name: Chocobo
options.tip: A chocobo in place of the game's mouse pointer.

options.name: Game's Pointer
options.tip: Keeps the game's own mouse pointer.

options.name: Where You Are
options.tip: The zone, its weather and what is around you.

options.name: Time
options.tip: Your computer's time.

options.name: You
options.tip: Your job, experience, gil, inventory, party and target.

options.name: System
options.tip: Your frame rate, connection, memory and the game's help line.

options.name: NPCs & Objects
options.tip: Shops, quest givers, doors and the like.

options.name: Players
options.tip: Other players, and you.

options.name: Mobs
options.tip: Monsters.

options.name: Pets
options.tip: Pets, avatars and the like, yours or others'.

options.name: No Target
options.tip: While nothing is targeted, it says No target.

options.name: Links
options.tip: It joins in when you fight one of its kind.

options.name: Sight
options.tip: It sees you.

options.name: True Sight
options.tip: It sees through invisible and sneak.

options.name: Sound
options.tip: It hears you.

options.name: Scent
options.tip: It smells you.

options.name: Use of Spells
options.tip: Casting near it draws it.

options.name: Use of Abilities
options.tip: Using an ability near it draws it.

options.name: Low Player HP
options.tip: Low HP near it draws it.

options.name: Star
options.tip: Still blue, with a star after it.

options.name: Plain Text
options.tip: In the pop-out's usual color, like any other TP move.

options.name: Zone Name
options.tip: The zone you are in.

options.name: Region Name
options.tip: The zone's region.

options.name: Conquest Icon
options.tip: The crest of the nation that holds the region; a nation's own in its city, Jeuno's in Jeuno, and Aht Urhgan's in the regions of its Besieged map.

options.name: Conquest Nation
options.tip: The name of the nation that holds the region.

options.name: Weather Icon
options.tip: The weather's picture, as Use Custom Icons picks it.

options.name: Weather Name
options.tip: The weather now.

options.name: Vana'diel Date
options.tip: Vana'diel's date.

options.name: Vana'diel Weekday
options.tip: Vana'diel's day, in its element's color.

options.name: Vana'diel Time
options.tip: Vana'diel's time.

options.name: Moon Phase
options.tip: The moon's phase and how full it is.

options.name: Aggression
options.tip: Whether a mob is aggressive or passive.

options.name: Name
options.tip: Your target's name.

options.name: Distance
options.tip: How far your target is, in yalms.

options.name: Detection
options.tip: How a mob detects you, as Detection Icons picks.

options.name: Level
options.tip: A mob's level and how tough it is.

options.name: Player Info
options.tip: A player's jobs and levels, once HeadsUp knows them: from your party, a check, or Look Up Players.

options.name: Weaknesses
options.tip: What a mob is weak to.

options.name: Coin Icon
options.tip: Gil's coin, beside both lines, whichever currencies the widget shows.

options.name: Currency 1 Name
options.tip: The first currency's name.

options.name: Currency 2 Name
options.tip: The second currency's name.

options.name: Currency 1 Amount
options.tip: How much of the first currency you have.

options.name: Currency 2 Amount
options.tip: How much of the second currency you have.

options.name: Currency 1 Icon
options.tip: The first currency's picture from the game, where it has one: gil's coin, a nation's crest for conquest points, or the item for seals, crests and beastcoins.

options.name: Currency 2 Icon
options.tip: The second currency's picture from the game, where it has one: gil's coin, a nation's crest for conquest points, or the item for seals, crests and beastcoins.

options.name: Count
options.tip: The bag's used and total slots.

options.name: Bag Name
options.tip: The bag's name.

options.name: Bag Icon
options.tip: A bag's picture.

options.name: Local Time
options.tip: The time in your Local Timezone.

options.name: Secondary Timezone
options.tip: The time in your Secondary Timezone, Japan's by default.

options.name: Vana'diel Time
options.tip: The time in Vana'diel.

options.name: Clock Icon
options.tip: A clock's picture.

options.name: Local Date
options.tip: Your computer's date, as Date Format writes it.

options.name: Job Info
options.tip: Your jobs and levels, as Job Text shows them.

options.name: Earned EXP
options.tip: The EXP you have of this level, out of what it takes. At the level cap, your limit points.

options.name: EXP Til Next Level
options.tip: The EXP left to the next level. At the level cap, your merits.

options.name: EXP Percentage
options.tip: How much of the level you have, as a percent.

options.name: EXP Bar
options.tip: How much of the level you have, as a bar.

options.name: FPS
options.tip: Frames per second.

options.name: Sent
options.tip: Bytes sent each second; amber or red when data stops.

options.name: Received
options.tip: Bytes received each second; amber or red when data stops.

options.name: Percent
options.tip: The game's own connection meter, as its readout shows it: 100% while data comes in, less once it stops.

options.name: Memory
options.tip: The game's memory used; amber, then red, as it runs low before it runs out at 4 GB.

options.name: Messages
options.tip: PlayOnline's mail and messenger icons while something waits, with how many.

options.name: Party Size
options.tip: How many are in your party, or Solo.

options.name: HP and MP
options.tip: The lowest HP and MP in your party.

options.name: Pinned Status #1

Reload
words.tip: Reads settings_window.json from config/headsup again and builds this window from it, or from the built-in one when there is none.

words.name: Export
words.tip: Writes the built-in settings_window.json to config/headsup, where it can be edited and read with Reload.

words.name: Start
words.tip: Starts Setup.

words.name: Skip Setup
words.tip: Closes Setup and keeps the defaults. You can run it again any time with /hu setup.

words.name: Back
words.tip: Goes back a step.

words.name: Next
words.tip: Goes on to the next step.

words.name: Finish
words.tip: Keeps your picks and closes Setup.

words.name: Zoom
words.tip: Brings the picture nearer to the nameplates. You can also turn the mouse wheel over the picture.

words.name: Your Own
words.tip: You set these yourself in the settings window. Pick one of the others to replace them.

words.name: Advanced
words.tip: Shows each part of this step's preset on its own, to change in detail.

words.name: Hide Advanced
words.tip: Hides the parts of each step's preset again. What you changed stays.

words.name: Cancel
words.tip: Puts back the settings you had before Setup and closes it.

words.name: WARNING
words.tip: Setup changes your settings as you pick. Your settings are saved to {file} first, and Cancel puts them back.

words.name: Welcome to HeadsUp
words.tip: HeadsUp outlines mobs by whether they will attack you and draws its own nameplates over the game's. These steps set the main things, with a preview of each. Everything else is in the settings window: type /hu to open it.

words.name: Theme
words.tip: Pick how the Top Panel looks. The settings window takes on the same look. Advanced has the fonts and sizes.

words.name: Nameplates
words.tip: Pick how much the nameplates and outlines show. Advanced has each part on its own: which mobs, what a nameplate shows, outlines, players, NPCs, pets and where each line sits.

words.name: Top Panel
words.tip: Pick how much the Top Panel shows. Advanced turns each widget on or off. You can move each widget and change what it shows in the settings window.

words.name: Options
words.tip: Pick your target cursor and mouse pointer, and a few things HeadsUp can do for you.
